title: ticket.updated.v1 payload
description: Payload of the ticket.updated.v1 event, emitted by ticket-service when appeal card details change. To avoid leaking personal data, the payload lists which fields changed rather than their values; consumers re-read the card if they need the new values (docs/06, ADR-006). Marked PII because the set of changed fields may reference personal-data fields.

changedFields.description: Names of the ticket-card fields that changed in this update.
